name: Gab – Custom User Avatar
author: Gabriele Iacovone

sections.description:
This simple and lightweight plugin removes Gravatars and allow users to upload a custom avatar image from WordPress media library.

Features:
1. Upload an image from media library as your profile picture.
2. Set a default avatar for guest users in Setting > Discussion.

Advantages:
* Avoid blog post comments with empty users profiles pictures.
* Improve performances (only 2 images are loaded).
sections.installation:
1. Upload gab-custom-avatar directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Now you have a new option in the user page
sections.faq:
Can I change my avatar uploading an image from my device?

Yes, you can upload your image in WordPress Media Library and after that will be available in your profile page.

short_description: Allow users to add or remove their avatar using images from WordPress media library and set a default avatar for guests.
